NP Presspad 1.2.1 — Safer image downloads

A small follow-up to 1.2.0. **No companion plugin update needed** for this one.

## What's new for you

- **Images are now checked for a secure connection at every step.** When the app downloads an image from your site, the address it starts with was checked but any redirect afterwards wasn't — so a site that redirected an image to an unencrypted address could have its images read or altered in transit on the way into your library. Every hop is now checked, and a download that would end up unencrypted is skipped rather than saved.
- **Image downloads can no longer hang indefinitely.** They previously had no time limit at all. A download that stalls now gives up after two minutes and is retried on the next sync.
- **Custom field values arrive in a consistent format.** Some sites are configured to hand out field values formatted for display rather than for editing, which meant dates could arrive in a form the editor couldn't read or save back. The app now asks for the editing format explicitly, so that setting no longer affects it.

No dependency changes in this release.
